stem: A web performance study measures the response time (ms) for a sample of 40 website users. The sample mean is 1011.1 ms with a sample standard deviation of 278.9 ms. Assuming the data are approximately normally distributed, estimate the true population mean and provide a 95% confidence interval.

ground_truth.answer: Population mean ≈ 1011.1 ms. 95% CI = [921.9, 1100.3]. Point estimate: 1011.1 ms.

common_failure_modes: Using z-critical value instead of t-critical for small samples
Not reporting the confidence interval alongside the point estimate
